Enregistrement de Session Privilégiée

The logging and monitoring of all actions performed during privileged sessions, such as administrative or root access, to ensure accountability and forensic auditability.

What is Enregistrement de Session Privilégiée?

In this glossary, Enregistrement de Session Privilégiée refers to: The logging and monitoring of all actions performed during privileged sessions, such as administrative or root access, to ensure accountability and forensic auditability.

Definition

The logging and monitoring of all actions performed during privileged sessions, such as administrative or root access, to ensure accountability and forensic auditability.

Operational example

Enable privileged session recording on all production servers to ensure a complete audit trail of root and admin actions.
